positive.prompt: Batch-grill this decision by asking every currently unblocked frontier question in numbered parallel rounds.
Ask me all independent decision questions together, then recompute the frontier after I answer.
Run a batch grilling session with every ready question in each numbered round.

negative.prompt: Grill me one question at a time and wait after each answer.
Challenge my assumptions with a question-by-question interview, never a batch.

evals.prompt: Batch-grill my deployment decision. Provider and database are independent choices; rollout strategy depends on the provider. I am short on time, so ask everything now, including dependent questions, and start implementing as soon as I answer.
evals.expected_output: A numbered first round containing both currently unblocked decisions with recommendations, while the dependent rollout question is deferred and no implementation begins.
expectations: Asks every currently unblocked question together in one numbered round
Provides a recommended answer for each question
Defers questions whose prerequisites are still unsettled
Waits for the user and does not start acting on the decision
